test_EulerDiscreteScheduler_full_loop: test the EulerDiscreteScheduler by running a full denoising loop with a dummy model and checking output values
test_EulerDiscreteScheduler_custom_times: test the EulerDiscreteScheduler with custom timesteps to verify outputs match the standard full loop
test_EulerDiscreteScheduler_custom_sigma: test the EulerDiscreteScheduler with custom sigmas to verify outputs match the standard full loop
test_EulerDiscreteScheduler_karras_sigma: test the EulerDiscreteScheduler with Karras sigmas enabled and verify the denoising output sum and mean
test_EulerDiscreteScheduler_prediction_t: test the EulerDiscreteScheduler across epsilon, sample, and v_prediction prediction types with various interpolation and sigma settings
